result.instructions: Tools for Zenbooker, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What jobs are scheduled for tomorrow and who is assigned to each?"; "Find the customer with phone 555-0134 and show their past jobs."; "Which invoices are still unpaid this month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Zenbooker data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zenbooker_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zenbooker_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zenbooker_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. zenbooker_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zenbooker_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs (booked appointments), by start time by default, with filters: customer id, assigned team member id, territory id, recurring booking id, status, canceled flag, creation time and scheduled start window. Returns { results, count, has_more, next_cursor }; pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page. GET /v1/jobs.

customer.description: Only jobs of this customer id.

assigned.description: Only jobs assigned to this team member (service provider) id.

territory.description: Only jobs in this service territory id.

recurring_booking.description: Only jobs that belong to this recurring booking id.

canceled.description: true = only canceled jobs, false = only jobs that are not canceled.

start_date_min.description: Only jobs scheduled to start on or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

start_date_max.description: Only jobs scheduled to start on or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_after.description: Only items created after this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_before.description: Only items created before this ISO 8601 date-time.

cursor.description: Where to start in the list (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_cursor.

tools.name: zenbooker_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: One job by id: appointment time, status, customer, service address, services and fields, assigned providers, notes and invoice summary. GET /v1/jobs/{id}.

job_id.description: The Zenbooker id (the id field of a list result).

tools.name: zenbooker_add_job_note
tools.title: Add a note to a job
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note (text) to a job. Notes are appended, never replaced, and cannot be deleted through this server, so check the job first. POST /v1/jobs/{id}/notes.

job_id.description: The Zenbooker id (the id field of a list result).

annotations.title: Add a note to a job

tools.name: zenbooker_list_recurring_bookings
tools.title: List recurring bookings
tools.description: List recurring bookings (repeating job series), by status (active or canceled), customer id, assigned team member id, territory id or creation time. Max 40 per page. Returns { results, count, has_more, next_cursor }. GET /v1/recurring.

status.description: Only recurring bookings with this status.

customer.description: Only recurring bookings of this customer id.

assigned.description: Only recurring bookings assigned to this team member id.

territory.description: Only recurring bookings in this service territory id.

created_after.description: Only items created after this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_before.description: Only items created before this ISO 8601 date-time.

cursor.description: Where to start in the list (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_cursor.

tools.name: zenbooker_get_recurring_booking
tools.title: Get recurring booking
tools.description: One recurring booking by id: first job date, job count, time slot, status, territory, service, pricing and its job ids. GET /v1/recurring/{id}.

recurring_booking_id.description: The Zenbooker id (the id field of a list result).

tools.name: zenbooker_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List or search customers by name, email or phone, by creation time, or by default address near a place (location + radius in miles). Returns { results, count, has_more, next_cursor }. GET /v1/customers.

location.description: A place or address; finds customers whose default address is near it (geocoded by Zenbooker).

radius.description: Search radius in miles, used with location.

created_after.description: Only items created after this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_before.description: Only items created before this ISO 8601 date-time.

cursor.description: Where to start in the list (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_cursor.

tools.name: zenbooker_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer by id: contact details, notes, addresses, job and recurring booking ids and linked Stripe customer. GET /v1/customers/{id}.

customer_id.description: The Zenbooker id (the id field of a list result).

tools.name: zenbooker_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer record in Zenbooker (name required; phone and email optional). It does not look for an existing customer, so search with zenbooker_list_customers first to avoid duplicates. POST /v1/customers.

tools.name: zenbooker_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices, optionally by status (draft, unpaid, partial_paid, paid, void), customer id, territory id or creation time. Each invoice has line items, totals, amount paid and due and its transactions. Returns { results, count, has_more, next_cursor }. GET /v1/invoices.

status.description: Only invoices in this status (default: any status).

customer.description: Only invoices of this customer id.

territory.description: Only invoices in this service territory id.

created_after.description: Only items created after this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_before.description: Only items created before this ISO 8601 date-time.

cursor.description: Where to start in the list (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_cursor.

tools.name: zenbooker_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id: recipient, line items, discounts, tax, totals, amount paid and due, status and transactions. GET /v1/invoices/{id}.

invoice_id.description: The Zenbooker id (the id field of a list result).

tools.name: zenbooker_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List payment transactions, optionally by type (stripe_payment, external_transaction), payment method, status (succeeded, failed, voided), customer id, territory id, creation time or payment date. Returns { results, count, has_more, next_cursor }. GET /v1/transactions.

payment_method.description: Only transactions paid by this method.

customer.description: Only transactions of this customer id.

territory.description: Only transactions in this service territory id.

transaction_date_after.description: Only transactions dated after this ISO 8601 date-time.

transaction_date_before.description: Only transactions dated before this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_after.description: Only items created after this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_before.description: Only items created before this ISO 8601 date-time.

cursor.description: Where to start in the list (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_cursor.

tools.name: zenbooker_get_transaction
tools.title: Get transaction
tools.description: One payment transaction by id: status, type, method, amount, invoice and customer ids, Stripe references. GET /v1/transactions/{id}.

transaction_id.description: The Zenbooker id (the id field of a list result).

category_id.description: Only services in this category id.

created_after.description: Only items created after this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_before.description: Only items created before this ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: zenbooker_list_territories
tools.title: List service territories
tools.description: List the service territories (areas a business serves) with timezone, service area, providers and operating hours. Use the ids to filter jobs and invoices or to look up time slots. GET /v1/territories.

enabled.description: true = only active territories, false = only deactivated ones (default both).

created_after.description: Only items created after this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_before.description: Only items created before this ISO 8601 date-time.

cursor.description: Where to start in the list (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_cursor.

tools.name: zenbooker_get_territory
tools.title: Get service territory
tools.description: One service territory by id. GET /v1/territories/{id}.

territory_id.description: The Zenbooker id (the id field of a list result).

tools.name: zenbooker_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List team members (staff and service providers) with role, status, assigned territories, skill tags and work hours. Use the ids to filter jobs by assigned provider. GET /v1/team_members.

service_provider.description: true = only team members who can be assigned jobs.

deactivated.description: true = only deactivated team members, false = only active ones.

territory.description: Only providers assigned to this service territory id.

email.description: Find a team member by email address.

created_after.description: Only items created after this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_before.description: Only items created before this ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: zenbooker_get_team_member
tools.title: Get team member
tools.description: One team member by id: contact details, role, status, territories, skill tags and work hours. GET /v1/team_members/{id}.

team_member_id.description: The Zenbooker id (the id field of a list result).

tools.name: zenbooker_list_service_requests
tools.title: List service requests
tools.description: List incoming service requests (booking requests and quote requests) with status, customer, territory, duration, requested dates, services and pricing. Returns { results, count, has_more, next_cursor }. GET /v1/service_requests.

customer.description: Only requests of this customer id.

territory.description: Only requests in this service territory id.

created_after.description: Only items created after this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_before.description: Only items created before this ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: zenbooker_check_service_area
tools.title: Check service area
tools.description: Check whether a location is inside the business's service area: returns in_service_area, the matching territory and other territories that serve it (or the closest territory when it is outside every area). Give a postal code, an address, or lat + lng. GET /v1/scheduling/service_area_check.

address.description: Street address (needed only when there is no postal code or lat/lng).

tools.name: zenbooker_get_timeslots
tools.title: Get available time slots
tools.description: Available booking time slots for a service territory, grouped by day (days[].timeslots[] with start, end and id). Needs the territory id (zenbooker_list_territories or zenbooker_check_service_area) and the service duration in minutes. GET /v1/scheduling/timeslots.

date.description: First day to check, yyyy-mm-dd (default today).

days.description: How many days to return (default 7, max 60).

lat.description: Customer latitude (for drive-time aware availability); send with lng.

min_providers_needed.description: Minimum number of providers a slot needs (default 1).

service_providers.description: Comma-separated team member ids to restrict slots to.

required_skills.description: Comma-separated skill tag ids a provider must have.
